name: Data.hasRoute_succ
summary: Move the descent of each grid past j lifts (`Data.descent_past_gridPathMap`: a denominator of cost j and an increase 2j of the order of the short sum, for each grid), cross the square at (j, j) (`Data.IsTidy.exists_square_move`, with the Fourier square law of the flipped kernel of the line), and compare the periods with the seesaw identity for the subdiagonal space (`seesaw_periods`), the flip costing a power of the residue count.

steps.claim: t is odd; the space Z_{j,j+1} is V_{j+1,j} reindexed (ι, ν, s; `Data.gridSpace_subdiag`); the flip identity of the theta kernel of the line (H, `exists_modKernel_flip_line`, sign −(−1)^j); the square law of the grid (κ₀, σ, c₃ costing one square, Q; `Data.exists_squareLaw_grid` at (j, j)).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨t, o⟩, ⟨ι, ν, s⟩, H, κ₀, σ, c₃, g₃, Q⟩ := D.t_odd, gridSpace_subdiag j,
    exists_modKernel_flip_line (gridSpace ..) (-(-1) ^ j), exists_squareLaw_grid false h h

steps.claim: Rewrite the sign: −(−(−1)^j) = (−1)^{j+1}.
steps.lean: rw [neg_neg, ← mul_neg_one (_ ^ j), ← pow_succ] at H

steps.claim: Name the flipped polynomial τ.
steps.lean: generalize flipPoly (E := D.E) _ _ = τ at H

steps.claim: For both grids, constants κ₁, c₁ (cost j) and moves H₁ of a descent past j lifts (`Data.descent_past_gridPathMap` at a = b = j); let N be the index set of V_{j+1,j}.
steps.lean: choose κ₁ c₁ g₁ H₁ using (descent_past_gridPathMap h · .refl); let N := D.GridIndex false j.succ j

steps.claim: For every ϑ: an additive character ψ(ϑ), a constant c(ϑ) with |c(ϑ)|²·|matrices| = 1 (hc), and the flip identity H(ϑ) for the modulus and the grid characters.
steps.lean:
choose ψ c hc H using fun ϑ ↦
    H (gridModulus ϑ) (gridChar ϑ false j N) (gridChar ϑ true j N) (Modulus.flipScalar _ ^ j)

steps.claim: Take d = c₁(false)·c₁(true)·c₃·c⁻¹: its costs add up to j + j + 1 + 0 = 2j + 1 ≤ 4j + 2 (`Data.CostsSquares.mul`; c⁻¹ costs nothing, `Data.CostsSquares.of_norm_sq_eq_mul_card_zpow`), so it costs 4j + 2 squares: HasRoute has one bound, 4j + 2, both for the cost of d and for the increase of the order (2j for each of the two ladders and 2 for the square); fix n, Λ tidy.
steps.lean:
use c₁ false * c₁ true * c₃ * c⁻¹,
    (((g₁ _).mul (g₁ _) .refl).mul g₃ .refl).mul (.of_norm_sq_eq_mul_card_zpow _ 1
    (card N) (by simpa [field, eq_comm] using hc)) (by omega), fun n Λ hΛ ↦ ?_

steps.claim: Move the descent of the first grid: Φ₁ tidy (q₁) with the move e₁.
steps.lean: choose Φ₁ q₁ e₁ using (H₁ _ · _ _ _ (by simp [gridPath, legEdges]) (hΛ _))

steps.claim: Move the descent of the second grid: Φ₂ (q₂, e₂).
steps.lean: choose Φ₂ q₂ e₂ using (H₁ _ · _ _ _ (by simp [gridPath, legEdges]) (q₁ _))

steps.claim: Rewrite the edge set of q₂.
steps.lean: simp [↓Finset.insert_union] at q₂

steps.claim: Let u = gridDiagEquiv.
steps.lean: let u := D.gridDiagEquiv

steps.claim: Cross the square (j, j) with `Data.IsTidy.exists_square_move` (identifications ι⁻¹, u, u; ψ(ϑ); the law Q(ϑ); admissibility and node conditions): Φ₀ tidy (q₀) with the identity e₀.
steps.lean:
choose Φ₀ q₀ e₀ using (q₂ · |>.exists_square_move (_, _, _) ι.symm (u _) (u _) (ψ _) (Q _) (R :=
    (_, _, _)) (by simp [IsAdmissibleFamily, update, h.ne']; clear * -; bound)
    (by simp [gridPath, legEdges]; clear * - h; grind))

steps.claim: Take Φ₀ (its edge set is path(j + 1)); fix T, the hypothesis X on the periods of Φ₀ and a real point g.
steps.lean: use Φ₀, by simpa +arith [path, gridPath, Finset.range_add_one] using q₀, fun T X g ↦ ?_

steps.claim: The short sums of the data (E); the reindexing e of real points through ν.
steps.lean: choose _ _ _ _ _ _ E using @IsTidy.isShortSum _ D; let e := (G.reindex (E := D.E) _ ν).symm

steps.claim: e is continuous (`G.continuous_reindex`).
steps.lean: have : Continuous e := G.continuous_reindex _ (by simp [← ν, comp_def])

steps.claim: The height of e(x) is that of x (`Space.height_reindex`).
steps.lean: have t x := by simpa [e, ← s] using (gridSpace ..).height_reindex _ ν (e x)

steps.claim: Apply the seesaw identity of periods (`seesaw_periods`) to the edge families of the grid (`Data.isEdgeFamily_grid`) with the constants T/(c₃/c): the periods of Λ are β times κ₁κ₁·T/d, provided the span condition (left) holds; the constants of the moves e₁, e₂ and X are inserted.
steps.lean:
refine (seesaw_periods _ (c := fun x ↦ T x / (c₃ / c) x.1) (T := gridSpace ..) (E <|
    q₂ ·.1) (isEdgeFamily_grid (·.1) true rfl) (isEdgeFamily_grid _ false rfl) fun P _ ↦ mul_le.2 ?_
    (mem_rename_range_mul (.map id (.map ι.symm (u _ ∘ .inl))) (.map id (.map ι.symm (u _ ∘ .inr)))
    (by simp [reindex_equiv (u _)]) P)).imp' (κ₁ false * κ₁ true * ·) fun β b x ↦
    ((e₁ _ _ (fun S ↦ diagonalPeriodForm _ _ g _) ?_).trans congr(_ * $((e₂ _ _ (fun S ↦
    (diagonalPeriodForm _ h.le g).flip _) ?_).trans congr(_ * $(b x))))).trans (by simp [field])

steps.claim: The span condition: take the generating elements (A, B).
steps.lean: rintro _ ⟨A, rfl⟩ _ ⟨B, rfl⟩

steps.claim: Let K(𝔪, a, z, Ψ) be the moderate weight z·modKernel(…) of the flipped line (continuous, moderate by `pairThetaKer`'s moderateness and the heights).
steps.lean:
let K 𝔪 a z Ψ : ModerateWeight (gridSpace ..) (gridSpace ..) := ⟨⟨fun x ↦
    z * modKernel (gridSpace ..) (signedSpace _ fun _ ↦ (-1) ^ j.succ) a WeilData.upsilonU1 𝔪 Ψ
    (τ B) (e x) (1, 𝔪.flipScalar ^ j * 𝔪.flipScalar), by fun_prop [modKernel]⟩, ⟨e, ‹_›⟩, ⟨_, _, (by
    simp; grw [modKernel, pairTheta, ((pairThetaKer ..).isModerate ..).choose_spec.choose_spec, t ·,
      mul_assoc])⟩, 1, by simp [t, e]⟩

steps.claim: The period against K with a Fourier transformed datum is z times the sum over k of ψ(tr(kx)) times the periods against the single data (Z).
steps.lean:
have Z 𝔪 a z ψ x r G (F y : GridForm ..) : periodPairing G (K 𝔪 a z (matrixFourier ψ (Pi.single
    x 1))) r F y = z * ∑ k, ψ (k * x).trace * periodPairing G (K 𝔪 a 1 (Pi.single k 1)) r F y := by
    simp [periodPairing, ← integral_const_mul, ← integral_finsetSum,
      (integrable_moderate_mul_forms G ..).const_mul]
    simp [K, modKernel, pairTheta, modDatum_eq_sum _ _ (matrixFourier _ _), matrixFourier,
      Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]; ac_rfl
steps.typed_fact:
periodPairing G (K 𝔪 a z (matrixFourier ψ (Pi.single
    x 1))) r F y = z * ∑ k, ψ (k * x).trace * periodPairing G (K 𝔪 a 1 (Pi.single k 1)) r F y

steps.claim: The generators lie in the span: by the seesaw identity for q₀, X and Z, each generator is a combination of the periods of Φ₀ (the four goals below).
steps.lean:
refine' subset_span ⟨A, _, _, fun r ↦ (seesaw_periods _ (E <| q₀ ·.1) (isEdgeFamily_grid _ true
    rfl) (isEdgeFamily_grid _ false rfl) fun _ _ ↦ subset_span ⟨_, _, _, X, fun _ _ _ _ ↦ _⟩).imp'
    (κ₀ * ·) fun β b o ↦ (congrArg _ (funext fun S ↦ Z ..)).trans ((map_smul _ (c o.1).1 _).trans
    (congr(_ * $((e₀ _ (fun S k ↦ (gridPathMap S _ j _ (levelIndex .. • o.2.1),
    periodPairing _ (K _ (gridChar o.1 true j N) 1 (Pi.single k 1)) r (gridPathMap S _ j
    _ o.2.2))) _).trans congr(_ * $(b o)))).trans (by simp [field]))), fun _ _ _ _ ↦ _⟩

steps.claim: The fourth goal: the kernel identity, by the flip H and the summation and reindexing of modular kernels (`modKernel_sum_left`, `modKernel_reindex`).
steps.lean:
on_goal 4 => simp [K]; erw [← H, eq_comm, mul_comm, ← modKernel_sum_left,
    ← modKernel_reindex (u _) (D.gridDiagEquiv_spec h.le) _ ν, ← gridSpace_diag h.le, ← s]; congr 1

steps.claim: The second goal: likewise on the right (`modKernel_sum_right`).
steps.lean:
on_goal 2 => simp [K]; erw [mul_comm, ← modKernel_sum_right, ← modKernel_reindex _ ν
    (u _) (D.gridDiagEquiv_spec h), ← gridSpace_diag h, ← s]; congr! -closePost 1

steps.claim: Goals of path maps depending only on the edges (`Data.gridPathMap_congr`).
steps.lean: any_goals exact (by simp +contextual [gridPathMap_congr · ·])

steps.claim: The character and size identities (grid characters, sizes of index sets, powers).
steps.lean:
all_goals clear * - o e u; simp [gridChar, card_gridIndex, mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, *, e,
    funext_iff, ← ext_iff, reindex_equiv ι.symm, reindex_equiv (u _), Prod.map_comp_map] <;> grind
